name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – § 25
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: Supports the Commission President’s declaration that EU bilateral support to Israel will be put on hold and that all payments in these areas will stop, without affecting the EU’s work with Israeli civil society or Yad Vashem, and supports her proposal for a partial suspension of the EU-Israel Association Agreement with regard to trade-related matters;
